title: Looks nice
text: Looks nice. I needed a basement bar. The color of this goes perfect, a few things; this is very difficult to assemble. Instructions are included but it’s tough! It is possible for a patient team. As two people are needed to do it. Also some of the screws were very cheapo, so I swapped some out for better ones. After that it got sturdier. But like other reviews mentioned (I see now) the top cannot take any moisture . It will bubble up. Overal for the price it’s ok.

product_metadata.title: Coaster Home Furnishings Joe 5-Shelf Bar Unit Aged Oak
features: Rustic bar unit finished in aged oak
Metal footrest and details finished in dark bronze
Features five (5) shelves, stemware racks, and twelve (12)bottle wine rack
Constructed with steel, MDF, particle board, and engineered veneer
description: Serve up smile after smile at your next gathering of guests. This handsome, wooden bar unit boasts a bold, rustic design to enliven your space. Five roomy shelves with stemware racks provide plenty of space for your party essentials. A metal footrest is attached to the front, keeping guests comfortable as you show off your mixology skills. Top-quality craftsmanship ensures maximum durability for years of lasting enjoyment.
